# Skyline Ace

A standalone React Three Fiber rail-shooter vertical slice. It is an original,
asset-free homage to the *Star Fox 64* design vocabulary: fixed-rail movement,
wingmate rescues, barrel rolls, route landmarks, score chasing, and a staged
carrier boss. It intentionally does **not** ship Nintendo names, dialogue,
sounds, models, textures, level geometry, or ripped game data.

## Run

```sh
cd games/skyline-ace
npm install
npm run dev
```

Controls: `WASD`/arrow keys move, `Space` fires, `Shift` boosts, `E` barrels
roll, and `Q` drops a bomb. A/D or Left/Right double-tap also triggers the roll.

## Difficulty and targeting model

`src/game/difficulty.ts` is the single deterministic model. It normalizes route
progress to `distance / 420m` and clamps it to 0..1. Health rises to 1.9x,
fire intervals fall to 0.55x, projectile speed rises to 1.5x, aim lead rises
from 0.15x to 1x, accuracy rises from 34% to 94%, wave density rises to 1.5x,
and formation width rises to 1.22x. Extra formation members are deterministic,
never random, and use a floor so realized counts never exceed the displayed
multiplier cap. The carrier is a short, readable core fight (8 base armor,
scaled by route difficulty) with three health phases and enough approach time
for sustained player fire. Enemy fire, including turrets, solves a bounded
quadratic intercept using player position and velocity, clamps prediction to the
playable envelope, and applies a shrinking full-ID/shot-index seeded offset as
accuracy improves. The HUD exposes threat progress, aim accuracy, and wave
density for playtesting. `src/game/collision.ts` exports the pure swept-capsule
helper; this asset-free slice has no test framework, so `npm run build` is the
lightweight type/render validation check.

## Research notes

The first *Star Fox 64* stage, Corneria, is a forward-scrolling Arwing mission
with a coastal/city assault, three wingmates, rescue encounters, an optional
landmark route, score/medal replay incentives, and the Attack Carrier boss.
Those high-level, mechanically useful facts informed the encounter script.
Exact counts, timings, and route triggers should be verified from a licensed
copy and original footage before building any production-accurate campaign.

Reference reading:

- [StrategyWiki — Star Fox 64 / Corneria](https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Star_Fox_64/Corneria)
- [Star Fox Wiki — Corneria](https://starfox.fandom.com/wiki/Corneria)
- [Star Fox Wiki — Attack Carrier](https://starfox.fandom.com/wiki/Attack_Carrier)
- [Star Fox 64 instruction manual archive](https://www.gamesdatabase.org/Media/SYSTEM/Nintendo_N64/Manual/formated/Star_Fox_64_-_1997_-_Nintendo.pdf)

import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { useRef } from 'react'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE } from './difficulty'
import type { FlightRuntime } from './types'

export function Arwing({ flight }: { flight: FlightRuntime }) {
  const group = useRef<THREE.Group>(null)
  const leftPlume = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null)
  const rightPlume = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null)
  const barrelAngle = useRef(0)

  useFrame(({ clock }, delta) => {
    if (!group.current) return
    const frameDelta = Math.min(delta, 0.1)
    const { keys } = flight.input
    let horizontal = 0
    let vertical = 0
    if (keys.has('ArrowLeft') || keys.has('KeyA')) horizontal -= 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowRight') || keys.has('KeyD')) horizontal += 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowUp') || keys.has('KeyW')) vertical += 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowDown') || keys.has('KeyS')) vertical -= 1

    const speed = flight.world.boost ? 18 : 12
    flight.player.target.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(flight.player.target.x + horizontal * speed * frameDelta, PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE.minX, PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE.maxX)
    flight.player.target.y = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(flight.player.target.y + vertical * speed * frameDelta, PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE.minY, PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE.maxY)
    const follow = 1 - Math.exp(-14 * frameDelta)
    const previousPosition = flight.player.position.clone()
    group.current.position.lerp(flight.player.target, follow)
    flight.player.position.copy(group.current.position)
    flight.player.velocity.copy(flight.player.position).sub(previousPosition).multiplyScalar(1 / Math.max(frameDelta, 0.001))

    const now = flight.world.time
    const barrel = flight.player.barrel
    if (barrel.active) {
      const progress = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((now - barrel.startedAt) / 0.68, 0, 1)
      barrelAngle.current += barrel.direction * frameDelta * (Math.PI * 2 / 0.68)
      group.current.rotation.z = barrelAngle.current
      if (progress >= 1) {
        barrel.active = false
        barrelAngle.current = 0
      }
    } else {
      const bankTarget = -horizontal * 0.35
      group.current.rotation.z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(group.current.rotation.z, bankTarget, 1 - Math.exp(-10 * frameDelta))
    }

    const pulse = 0.82 + Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 18) * 0.12 + (flight.world.boost ? 0.32 : 0)
    if (leftPlume.current) leftPlume.current.scale.set(1, pulse, 1)
    if (rightPlume.current) rightPlume.current.scale.set(1, pulse * 0.94, 1)
  })

  return (
    <group ref={group} position={[0, 0, 2.5]}>
      <group scale={0.82}>
        <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.62, 2.9, 5]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#b5d9e7" metalness={0.86} roughness={0.24} emissive="#123d5d" emissiveIntensity={0.72} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, 0.05, 0.6]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.34, 1.15, 5]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#e9fbff" metalness={0.45} roughness={0.2} emissive="#287ca4" emissiveIntensity={0.8} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[-0.95, 0, 0.15]} rotation={[0, 0, -0.12]} castShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[1.85, 0.12, 0.85]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#7eb9d0" metalness={0.8} roughness={0.28} emissive="#0a2c49" emissiveIntensity={0.65} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0.95, 0, 0.15]} rotation={[0, 0, 0.12]} castShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[1.85, 0.12, 0.85]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#7eb9d0" metalness={0.8} roughness={0.28} emissive="#0a2c49" emissiveIntensity={0.65} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[-0.46, -0.15, 0.86]}>
          <boxGeometry args={[0.2, 0.4, 0.55]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#244f73" metalness={0.9} roughness={0.2} emissive="#0a2d52" emissiveIntensity={0.6} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0.46, -0.15, 0.86]}>
          <boxGeometry args={[0.2, 0.4, 0.55]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#244f73" metalness={0.9} roughness={0.2} emissive="#0a2d52" emissiveIntensity={0.6} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh ref={leftPlume} position={[-0.46, 0, 1.3]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.19, 1.05, 8]} />
          <meshBasicMaterial color="#6cf5ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.86} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh ref={rightPlume} position={[0.46, 0, 1.3]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.19, 1.05, 8]} />
          <meshBasicMaterial color="#6cf5ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.86} />
        </mesh>
        <pointLight position={[-0.46, 0, 1.2]} color="#31eaff" intensity={2.8} distance={7} />
        <pointLight position={[0.46, 0, 1.2]} color="#31eaff" intensity={2.8} distance={7} />
      </group>
    </group>
  )
}

export function CameraRig({ flight }: { flight: FlightRuntime }) {
  const { camera } = useThree()

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    const follow = 1 - Math.exp(-4.5 * delta)
    camera.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.position.x, flight.player.position.x * 0.22, follow)
    camera.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.position.y, 1.1 + flight.player.position.y * 0.12, follow)
    const perspectiveCamera = camera as THREE.PerspectiveCamera
    const desiredFov = flight.world.boost ? 72 : 58
    perspectiveCamera.fov = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(perspectiveCamera.fov, desiredFov, 1 - Math.exp(-5 * delta))
    perspectiveCamera.updateProjectionMatrix()
    camera.lookAt(flight.player.position.x * 0.12, flight.player.position.y * 0.1, -28)
  })

  return null
}

export function Reticle({ flight }: { flight: FlightRuntime }) {
  const reticle = useRef<THREE.Group>(null)

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    if (!reticle.current) return
    reticle.current.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(reticle.current.position.x, flight.player.position.x * 0.62, 1 - Math.exp(-8 * delta))
    reticle.current.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(reticle.current.position.y, flight.player.position.y * 0.62, 1 - Math.exp(-8 * delta))
    reticle.current.rotation.z += Math.min(delta, 0.1) * 0.35
  })

  return (
    <group ref={reticle} position={[0, 0, -24]}>
      <mesh>
        <ringGeometry args={[0.76, 0.81, 32]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#7df7ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.8} />

import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { useRef } from 'react'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE } from './difficulty'
import type { FlightRuntime } from './types'

export function Arwing({ flight }: { flight: FlightRuntime }) {
  const group = useRef<THREE.Group>(null)
  const leftPlume = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null)
  const rightPlume = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null)
  const barrelAngle = useRef(0)

  useFrame(({ clock }, delta) => {
    if (!group.current) return
    const frameDelta = Math.min(delta, 0.1)
    const { keys } = flight.input
    let horizontal = 0
    let vertical = 0
    if (keys.has('ArrowLeft') || keys.has('KeyA')) horizontal -= 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowRight') || keys.has('KeyD')) horizontal += 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowUp') || keys.has('KeyW')) vertical += 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowDown') || keys.has('KeyS')) vertical -= 1

    const speed = flight.world.boost ? 18 : 12
    flight.player.target.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(flight.player.target.x + horizontal * speed * frameDelta, PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE.minX, PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE.maxX)
    flight.player.target.y = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(flight.player.target.y + vertical * speed * frameDelta, PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE.minY, PLAYABLE_ENVELOPE.maxY)
    const follow = 1 - Math.exp(-14 * frameDelta)
    const previousPosition = flight.player.position.clone()
    group.current.position.lerp(flight.player.target, follow)
    flight.player.position.copy(group.current.position)
    flight.player.velocity.copy(flight.player.position).sub(previousPosition).multiplyScalar(1 / Math.max(frameDelta, 0.001))

    const now = flight.world.time
    const barrel = flight.player.barrel
    if (barrel.active) {
      const progress = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((now - barrel.startedAt) / 0.68, 0, 1)
      barrelAngle.current += barrel.direction * frameDelta * (Math.PI * 2 / 0.68)
      group.current.rotation.z = barrelAngle.current
      if (progress >= 1) {
        barrel.active = false
        barrelAngle.current = 0
      }
    } else {
      const bankTarget = -horizontal * 0.35
      group.current.rotation.z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(group.current.rotation.z, bankTarget, 1 - Math.exp(-10 * frameDelta))
    }

    const pulse = 0.82 + Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 18) * 0.12 + (flight.world.boost ? 0.32 : 0)
    if (leftPlume.current) leftPlume.current.scale.set(1, pulse, 1)
    if (rightPlume.current) rightPlume.current.scale.set(1, pulse * 0.94, 1)
  })

  return (
    <group ref={group} position={[0, 0, 2.5]}>
      <group scale={0.82}>
        <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.62, 2.9, 5]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#b5d9e7" metalness={0.86} roughness={0.24} emissive="#123d5d" emissiveIntensity={0.72} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, 0.05, 0.6]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.34, 1.15, 5]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#e9fbff" metalness={0.45} roughness={0.2} emissive="#287ca4" emissiveIntensity={0.8} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[-0.95, 0, 0.15]} rotation={[0, 0, -0.12]} castShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[1.85, 0.12, 0.85]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#7eb9d0" metalness={0.8} roughness={0.28} emissive="#0a2c49" emissiveIntensity={0.65} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0.95, 0, 0.15]} rotation={[0, 0, 0.12]} castShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[1.85, 0.12, 0.85]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#7eb9d0" metalness={0.8} roughness={0.28} emissive="#0a2c49" emissiveIntensity={0.65} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[-0.46, -0.15, 0.86]}>
          <boxGeometry args={[0.2, 0.4, 0.55]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#244f73" metalness={0.9} roughness={0.2} emissive="#0a2d52" emissiveIntensity={0.6} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0.46, -0.15, 0.86]}>
          <boxGeometry args={[0.2, 0.4, 0.55]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#244f73" metalness={0.9} roughness={0.2} emissive="#0a2d52" emissiveIntensity={0.6} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh ref={leftPlume} position={[-0.46, 0, 1.3]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.19, 1.05, 8]} />
          <meshBasicMaterial color="#6cf5ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.86} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh ref={rightPlume} position={[0.46, 0, 1.3]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.19, 1.05, 8]} />
          <meshBasicMaterial color="#6cf5ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.86} />
        </mesh>
        <pointLight position={[-0.46, 0, 1.2]} color="#31eaff" intensity={2.8} distance={7} />
        <pointLight position={[0.46, 0, 1.2]} color="#31eaff" intensity={2.8} distance={7} />
      </group>
    </group>
  )
}

export function CameraRig({ flight }: { flight: FlightRuntime }) {
  const { camera } = useThree()

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    const follow = 1 - Math.exp(-4.5 * delta)
    camera.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.position.x, flight.player.position.x * 0.22, follow)
    camera.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.position.y, 1.1 + flight.player.position.y * 0.12, follow)
    const perspectiveCamera = camera as THREE.PerspectiveCamera
    const desiredFov = flight.world.boost ? 72 : 58
    perspectiveCamera.fov = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(perspectiveCamera.fov, desiredFov, 1 - Math.exp(-5 * delta))
    perspectiveCamera.updateProjectionMatrix()
    camera.lookAt(flight.player.position.x * 0.12, flight.player.position.y * 0.1, -28)
  })

  return null
}

export function Reticle({ flight }: { flight: FlightRuntime }) {
  const reticle = useRef<THREE.Group>(null)

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    if (!reticle.current) return
    reticle.current.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(reticle.current.position.x, flight.player.position.x * 0.62, 1 - Math.exp(-8 * delta))
    reticle.current.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(reticle.current.position.y, flight.player.position.y * 0.62, 1 - Math.exp(-8 * delta))
    reticle.current.rotation.z += Math.min(delta, 0.1) * 0.35
  })

  return (
    <group ref={reticle} position={[0, 0, -24]}>
      <mesh>
        <ringGeometry args={[0.76, 0.81, 32]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#7df7ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.8} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 4]}>
        <ringGeometry args={[1.14, 1.17, 4]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#49c5ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.64} />
      </mesh>
      <pointLight color="#4deaff" intensity={0.4} distance={4} />
    </group>
  )
}
